blind_audit.rationale: NR0B1 encodes DAX1, a nuclear regulatory protein important for development and function of the adrenal glands, hypothalamus, pituitary, and gonads. Loss can cause X-linked adrenal hypoplasia congenita with primary adrenal insufficiency and later hypogonadotropic hypogonadism.

nearest_material_review.tested_construct: MC2R is the adrenal ACTH receptor and signals predominantly through Gs to adenylyl cyclase, cAMP, and protein kinase A in zona fasciculata cells to promote cortisol steroidogenesis. Loss of MC2R function therefore produces ACTH resistance with low cortisol and compensatory high ACTH. Mineralocorticoid secretion is classically preserved because aldosterone production in the zona glomerulosa is regulated primarily by angiotensin II and extracellular potassium through calcium-dependent signaling rather than by ACTH.
